title: Self-paced /loop stops after one turn instead of rescheduling a fallback wakeup
symptoms: A self-paced /loop ends when a turn finishes without rescheduling
Loops that used to keep waking up on a fallback timer no longer do after 2.1.319
cause: Since 2.1.319 a self-paced /loop ends if the turn finishes without rescheduling. It no longer schedules a fallback wakeup.
fix: Set CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE=1 to restore the earlier keepalive behavior, or make sure the loop prompt always reschedules itself.
